name: Qorx
description: Local Rust MCP server that searches a source repository and returns focused excerpts with file paths and line numbers. Install: `cargo install --git https://github.com/bbrainfuckk/qorx --tag v1.0.7 --locked qorx` · [Configure `qorx mcp`](https://github.com/bbrainfuckk/qorx#connect-an-mcp-client).
